item.title: Pope Leo begins a 12-day, 3-country South America tour after his cancer surgery
item.description: Pope Leo begins his first South American tour since lung cancer surgery. The 12-day journey takes him to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, where he spent two decades.

item.title: After cancer surgery, Pope Leo embarks on Latin America trip
item.description: Pope Leo XIV is kicking off a three-nation tour of Latin America with a visit to Uruguay, three weeks after undergoing lung cancer surgery that had put the entire trip into question.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Bob Dylan comes knockin' on pope's door as Leo welcomes legend to Vatican
item.description: The American singer-songwriter and poet visited with the American pope at the Vatican during a break between concert dates in Italy. The Vatican said the encounter was brief.

item.title: How religion helped Democrats win control of Congress
item.description: Several Democratic members of the clergy, as well as a Texas seminarian, James Talarico, won their races for the House and Senate on Tuesday. Here's how religion helped them connect with voters

item.title: History in the mail: Pope Leo XIV becomes first pontiff to vote in a U.S. Election
item.description: How does an American Pope vote? By mail-in ballot! The Vatican says Pope Leo has done so, expressing his "belief in the right and the duty of citizens to participate in democratic processes."

item.title: How religion is influencing the midterm elections
item.description: Anti-Muslim rhetoric has heated up amid the Senate race in Michigan. Meanwhile, the Trump Administration promoted a meeting with Catholic bishops that some participants say left them feeling duped.

item.title: Why so many horror movies have Catholic themes
item.description: From exorcisms to demons, when it comes to creeping out audiences, directors often turn to religion. For some filmmakers, spirituality provides bewitching mix of the mundane and the supernatural.

item.description: The 1,300 survivors of sexual abuse by clergy members and lay workers have all agreed to the settlement, according to an attorney for some of the plaintiffs.

item.title: Pope Leo says he will gradually resume duties after cancer surgery
item.description: Pope Leo XIV thanked thousands of faithful in St. Peter's Square on Sunday for their prayers while he was hospitalized, and said he plans to gradually return to his usual duties.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV leaves hospital days after lung cancer surgery
item.description: The Pope left Rome's Gemelli Hospital Saturday, days after surgery for lung cancer removed the lower lobe of his right lung. He is currently scheduled to travel to Latin America in November.
